column1: # Review F's domain renames (REPORT §2.5, §3.5, §4.5, §6; API_1.0.md §3.4 "Domains (F)") as rewrite rules.  Hand-written.
# Columns and shapes as in core_renames.tsv, plus:
#   shape   method/N      as `method`, but only a call with exactly N arguments
#           in:<a|b|..>   `<seg>::old(` -> `<seg>::new(` where the path segment before `::` is one of the list
# The two table-driven rewrites of F (Distribution constructors, Matrix::get) are code: rules domains.dist-ctor
# and domains.matrix-get; their table is dist_ctors.tsv.

column7: F PE-KEEP: Ex::factor(var) -> factor_in(var). Run in the same pass as factor_all (the tool does)
F PE-WRAP: the new name exists today with another meaning; merge the two functions before applying
F M-EIG (the element type changes too: the compiler lists the readers)
F S-NAME (Distribution, RandomVariable); refused in a file with `impl Family for`
F M-NAME: `to_vec` is also a method of every slice; the receiver's type is not in the text
F P-CTOR: Option -> Result and the argument becomes a list of variables
F P-*: the tuple becomes a record
F P-*: a query becomes a value to compare
F S-NAME: `downcast_ref` is also std's `dyn Any` method
F S-KURT: the value changes by 3 on distributions, each site must be read
F S-PV: Option<&Ex> instead of a Result
F P-SYS: a function of the new name exists today (MultiPoly level)
F L-OUT: a field read becomes a `match`
